note: Ashley Park District campground on a point of Lake Hoskins, ~3 mi west of Ashley: primitive and modern sites, picnic shelters, playground, boat ramp and dock, fish-cleaning station. Park rule: campers park in the north shelterbelt. No rates or booking published; the city page says to call the park district for camping fees. --Claude
summary: City of Ashley tourism page confirms modern sites with water+electric, showers and dump (now manual); no rate, booking or season published. Phone should be the park district's 288-5142. Lakeview kept on imagery (pads 35-50 m from the west shore behind the loop road and a broken tree line).
